verdict.rationale: Bento documents a public API (Events API, Subscribers API) with explicit authentication conventions (HTTP Basic via publishable/secret keys), plus first-party SDKs, a 50+ command CLI, and an MCP server for AI-native access — collectively giving AI agents multiple documented ways to drive the product. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of the API's completeness.
